title: Supply Tenure at Exit and the C&I Exit Damages Rate
content:
> Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts: contract exits: supply tenure at exit.

The exit damages rate is scaled by the supply tenure at exit, the whole months from the service start date to the close date: 24 months or more scale it by 0.90, 12 up to 23 months scale it by 0.95, and a shorter tenure leaves it unscaled. Scaling multiplies the exit damages rate per kWh by the figure shown.

Whole months are calendar months from the service start date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the service start date.

| Supply tenure at exit | Exit damages rate multiplied by |
|---|---|
| 24 whole months or more | 0.90 |
| 12 to 23 whole months | 0.95 |
| 11 whole months or fewer | 1, unscaled |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical)

| Service start date | Close date | Whole months | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March 2024 | 28 February 2026 | 23 | 0.95 |
| 1 March 2024 | 1 March 2026 | 24 | 0.90 |
| 1 March 2025 | 28 February 2026 | 11 | 1 |
| 1 March 2025 | 1 March 2026 | 12 | 0.95 |
